## [0.7.1] - 2026-09-18

### 修复
- 音量浮层的滑动条长度不再随右侧读数变化：`5%`、`100%` 与静音时的条长保持一致。

### 变更
- 任意鼠标键点击都会立即关掉浮层，右键打开菜单时不会再被浮层压住。

### Fixed
- The volume overlay's slider no longer changes length with the read-out: `5%`, `100%` and the muted state all keep one length.

### Changed
- Any mouse button now dismisses the overlay immediately, so opening the menu with a right-click never leaves it on top.
